name: Suranjan
pharmacology_description: This is a unique combination of Colchicum (Colchicum luteum), Aloe (Aloe barbadensis) and other valuable natural ingredients. It is highly effective in all kinds of rheumatism such as chronic rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, sciatica, lumbago, gout, joint pain and muscular pain.
dosage_description: 1-2tablet(s) twice daily after meal or as directed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
